reviews.notes: Pinned rustls/ring/tls12 and HPACK, optional rcgen only for hosted pilot. Manifest is not installed dependency or runtime proof.
Capture described as transient original-hop evidence, not human attestation; exports TLS/H2 contexts only.
Exports strict hello assembler and same-transport PendingHandshake/Connection/revocation owner; module declarations not full integration evidence.

391 lines fully read in contiguous chunks. Pending socket owner before any TLS I/O, one original<=30s lifetime, prehandshake revocation handle, blocking I/O with remaining timeout, same rustls owner after handshake. Early data disabled and HRR refused. Cancellation atomically revokes before shutdown; handle Drop alone not cancellation. H1 idle probe rejects pending ciphertext/plaintext/partial record/EOF, point-in-time only; no disconnect-after-return guarantee. Borrowed hello/stream observations require live owner; ALPN negotiated separate from offered. Runtime owns request/body/audit ordering and worker join. No runtime execution performed.

79 lines fully read. Constant-state TLS record boundary limits socket reads to current header/payload; tests enumerate fragmentation, zero-length record and incomplete prefix. Not TLS semantic validation or traffic execution.

227 lines fully read in contiguous chunks. Sticky errors, bounded64KiB hello/18KiB records/128records; validates nested vectors/duplicate extensions and exact first-hello record completion before existing parser. Framing finish is not cryptographic handshake success or original-client hop authenticity.

151 lines fully read. Synthetic fragmentation/order/opaque ALPN, duplicate/malformed extensions, every truncated prefix, sticky errors and record budget. Source assertions do not establish actual TLS traffic or new test execution.

131 lines fully read. Span validation per HPACK representation before decoder; bounded128 fields/64KiB accounting, lower-case token names, control/edge-whitespace rejection, pseudo-header order/uniqueness and prohibited connection fields. Requires four pseudo headers and rejects CONNECT. Decoding ordered headers not HTTP2 stream lifecycle, origin integrity or independent parser proof.
